_comment: Edit this file to change the checklist, then run: npm run seed:build  (regenerates seed.sql)

Bathrooms: Clean including behind toilet cistern (no bugs/ants)
Clean off any bugs, dirt and grime
Pick up from floor and surfaces
Wipe down surfaces and remove bugs
Wipe with glass cleaner - no streaks
Empty, wipe over and replace liners
Mop all, including shower cubicles, check drains
Shelter: 1 x dish cloth, 1 x green scourer, 1 x metal scourer
Empty, wipe over and replace liners
Every visit: Check for and pick up any litter
Check BBQ is clean - report to Maintenance if not
Deliver to Reception with a note of where it was found and the date
Report any maintenance or damage (broken fittings, graffiti etc) with photos

areas.name: Brownsea specific
tasks: Check fridge is empty and clean
